justification: 8 files changed across robots.txt, sitemap restructure, JSON-LD schemas, and LGA page markup. All changes are static metadata/markup — no data queries, no user input processing, no runtime logic changes — but file count requires Standard tier.

pre_impl.existing_data: No data interaction — all changes are static markup/metadata. LGA pages already had FAQPage + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD; this adds Dataset schema alongside.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: ariScenarios field on FloodLgaData is string[] — checked .length > 0. If array shape changes, worst case is Dataset description omits ARI mention.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: N/A — no database operations. Schema additions are additive to existing page output.

functions.name: DatasetJsonLd
functions.input: name, description, url, spatialCoverage (string), variableMeasured (optional string[])
functions.output: script tag with JSON-LD Dataset markup
functions.if_none: variableMeasured is optional — omitted from output if undefined via conditional spread

functions.name: DefinedTermJsonLd
functions.output: script tag with JSON-LD DefinedTerm markup
functions.if_none: inDefinedTermSet is optional — omitted from output if undefined

functions.name: HowToJsonLd
functions.output: script tag with JSON-LD HowTo markup
functions.if_none: steps is required — empty array produces empty step list in valid JSON-LD

functions.name: DefinedTermSetJsonLd
functions.output: script tag with JSON-LD DefinedTermSet markup
functions.if_none: termCount is optional — omitted from output if falsy

functions.name: generateSitemaps
functions.input: no input — static array of 8 sitemap IDs
functions.output: array of 8 {id: number} objects for sitemap index
functions.if_none: N/A — static return, no external data dependency

values.nullable: no — always string[] per FloodLgaData interface
values.if_missing: Dataset description omits ARI mention, variableMeasured omits ARI entry — still valid

break_it.scenario: Sitemap returns empty for unknown id
break_it.what_happens: Valid empty XML sitemap returned — no user-visible impact, search engines see zero URLs for that segment
break_it.how: sitemap.ts:default — returns empty array which Next.js renders as valid empty sitemap XML. Only IDs 0-7 are registered in generateSitemaps().
break_it.repro: Visit /sitemap/99.xml — expect valid XML with zero URLs

break_it.scenario: JSON-LD schema has malformed data from LGA props
break_it.what_happens: Invalid JSON-LD in page source — no user-visible impact, Google structured data validator would flag it
break_it.how: All LGA data is static TypeScript arrays with typed interfaces — no runtime user input reaches schema content. lga is already guarded by notFound() before schema rendering.
break_it.repro: View page source on any LGA page, paste JSON-LD into Google Rich Results Test

break_it.scenario: llms.txt contains stale URLs after route changes
break_it.what_happens: AI crawlers follow dead links, get 404s — no data corruption, minor crawl waste
break_it.how: llms.txt is a static file — must be manually updated when routes change. Low risk since routes are stable.
break_it.repro: Check each URL in llms.txt returns 200

post_merge.manual_verify: Check /robots.txt shows AI crawler rules, /sitemap.xml shows sitemap index with 8 entries, /llms.txt is accessible, view-source on any granny-flat LGA page shows Dataset JSON-LD
